# Build System and Package Structure

The build page explains how the repository is packaged, built, exported, and prepared for local development or distribution.
## What Lives Here
- `docker/compose.yml` - Deployment configuration that explains how the product runs outside local development.
- `docker/docker-compose.self-host.yml` - Deployment configuration that explains how the product runs outside local development.
- `Dockerfile` - Deployment configuration that explains how the product runs outside local development.
- `package.json` - Package manifest that defines scripts, exports, and dependency boundaries.
- `vercel.json` - Deployment configuration that explains how the product runs outside local development.
## Build Inputs
- `build`: `pnpm run clean && tsc && pnpm run frontend:build && pnpm run copy:public && pnpm run verify:public` creates the production build or compiled package artifacts.
- `start`: `node dist/cli.js` starts the runtime process after dependencies or build output are ready.
- `dev`: `tsx src/cli.ts` starts the local development workflow.
- `test`: `vitest` runs verification for expected behavior.
- `release:no-build`: `bumpp && pnpm publish --access public --no-git-checks --tag next` creates the production build or compiled package artifacts.
- `geo:update`: `node scripts/download-geolite2.js` runs a repository-defined maintenance command.
- `copy:public`: `rm -rf dist/public && cp -r public dist/` runs a repository-defined maintenance command.
- `verify:public`: `test -f dist/public/index.html && echo '✓ Public directory copied successfully' || (echo '✗ ERROR: Public directory not copied!' && exit 1)` runs a repository-defined maintenance command.
